sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Off the coast of North Carolina, there's a thin stretch of islands called the Outer Banks.
sentences.zh: 在北卡罗来纳州海岸外，有一片狭长的岛屿，被称为外滩群岛。

sentences.en: Picture a narrow ribbon of sand that runs along the coast for 200 miles.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，一条绵延海岸线200英里的狭窄沙带。

sentences.en: These islands are three miles across at their widest, and only 200 yards at their narroweSt.
sentences.zh: 这些岛屿最宽处仅有三英里，最窄处甚至不到200码。

sentences.en: And there's one part of the Outer Banks that used to be especially treacherous for ships.
sentences.zh: 外滩群岛中有一部分曾经对船只来说极其危险。

sentences.en: It's called Cape Hatteras.
sentences.zh: 它被称为哈特拉斯角。

sentences.en: That's reporter Gordon Caddick of a podcast called Sighted.
sentences.zh: 那是播客《Sighted》的记者戈登·卡迪克。

sentences.en: The Cape is known for choppy seas and strong ocean currents.
sentences.zh: 哈特拉斯角以波涛汹涌的海面和强劲的洋流而闻名。

sentences.en: Since the 16th century, these waves have caused a lot of shipwrecks.
sentences.zh: 自16世纪以来，这些海浪导致了无数次海难。

sentences.en: Over a thousand, according to the National Park Service.
sentences.zh: 据国家公园管理局统计，超过一千起。

sentences.en: The area has become known as the Graveyard of the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 该地区因此被称为“大西洋的坟场”。

sentences.en: So many sailors were dying that in the late 1700s, Congress authorized the construction of a giant lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 由于遇难水手太多，18世纪末，国会授权建造一座巨大的灯塔。

sentences.en: It would illuminate the dangerous passage and make the Outer Banks less deadly.
sentences.zh: 它将照亮这条危险的航道，让外滩群岛不再那么致命。

sentences.en: The lighthouse went up in a small town called Buxton, North Carolina, right near Cape Hatteras.
sentences.zh: 灯塔建在北卡罗来纳州巴克斯顿的一个小镇上，就在哈特拉斯角附近。

sentences.en: And the people of Buxton, they love this lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 巴克斯顿的人民非常热爱这座灯塔。

sentences.en: Generations of families there have helped maintain it.
sentences.zh: 当地世世代代的家庭都参与了它的维护工作。

sentences.en: You know, it's what your grandfather did.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是你祖父辈做过的事。

sentences.en: It's what your great-grandfather did.
sentences.zh: 也是你曾祖父辈做过的事。

sentences.en: This is Danny Couch.
sentences.zh: 这位是丹尼·考奇。

sentences.en: He's descended from English pirates.
sentences.zh: 他是英国海盗的后裔。

sentences.en: And his family goes back nine generations in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 他的家族在北卡罗来纳州已经生活了九代人。

sentences.en: Today, Danny leads tours of the Outer Banks.
sentences.zh: 如今，丹尼负责带游客参观外滩群岛。

sentences.en: Gordon went on one of those tours last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，戈登参加了其中一次游览。

sentences.en: But we've got three maritime symbols in this country.
sentences.zh: 但我们国家有三个海事象征。

sentences.en: Number one, the Statue of Liberty.
sentences.zh: 第一，自由女神像。

sentences.en: Number two, the Golden Gate Bridge.
sentences.zh: 第二，金门大桥。

sentences.en: And then number three, the Granddaddy of American Lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 第三，美国灯塔之祖。

sentences.en: It's a 218-feet tall.
sentences.zh: 它有218英尺高。

sentences.en: The Cape Hatteras Lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 哈特拉斯角灯塔。

sentences.en: Bathroom's on the right.
sentences.zh: 洗手间在右边。

sentences.en: You can leave anything you need on board.
sentences.zh: 你们可以把需要的东西留在船上。

sentences.en: We don't have any crying here.
sentences.zh: 我们这里不许哭鼻子。

sentences.en: It is pretty majestic.
sentences.zh: 它确实非常宏伟。

sentences.en: It's got a red base and a really tall black and white spiral-y paint job,
sentences.zh: 它有着红色的底座，还有非常醒目的黑白螺旋条纹漆面，

sentences.en: sort of like a black and white candy cane.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像一根黑白相间的拐杖糖。

sentences.en: And I see some people on top.
sentences.zh: 我看到顶上有人。

sentences.en: It's a little observation deck.
sentences.zh: 那是一个小观景台。

sentences.en: There's a crowd of people waiting outside.
sentences.zh: 外面有一群人在等待。

sentences.en: A park ranger is standing near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 一位公园管理员正站在入口附近。

sentences.en: That's because this is all a national park.
sentences.zh: 那是因为这里整个都是国家公园。

sentences.en: This is the tallest brick lighthouse in North America that you all are about to climb today.
sentences.zh: 这是你们今天即将攀登的北美最高的砖砌灯塔。

sentences.en: So I hope everybody's ready to climb.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望大家都准备好攀登了。

sentences.en: It is a strenuous climb today.
sentences.zh: 今天的攀登会很费体力。

sentences.en: It's hard to overstate just how important this lighthouse is to the people of Buxton.
sentences.zh: 很难夸大这座灯塔对巴克斯顿人民有多重要。

sentences.en: There are three lighthouse gift shops in town.
sentences.zh: 镇上有三家灯塔礼品店。

sentences.en: Practically every business here has a lighthouse in its logo or its name,
sentences.zh: 几乎这里的每家企业都在其标志或名称中使用了灯塔，

sentences.en: like the Lighthouse View Motel or the Lighthouse Sports Bar and Grill.
sentences.zh: 比如“灯塔景观汽车旅馆”或“灯塔运动酒吧烧烤店”。

sentences.en: Even the churches, like the Lighthouse Christian Assembly.
sentences.zh: 甚至连教堂也一样，比如“灯塔基督教会”。

sentences.en: But back in the 70s, it looked like Buxton might lose their beloved lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 但在70年代，巴克斯顿似乎要失去他们心爱的灯塔了。

sentences.en: The sea was getting closer and closer, threatening to swallow it up.
sentences.zh: 大海正步步紧逼，威胁要将它吞没。

sentences.en: And people were torn over what to do.
sentences.zh: 人们对于该怎么做产生了分歧。

sentences.en: Move the lighthouse or leave it in place and try to defend it against the forces of nature.
sentences.zh: 是搬迁灯塔，还是原地不动并试图抵御大自然的侵袭。

sentences.en: For the next 30 years, the people of Buxton fought an intense political battle over this decision.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的30年里，巴克斯顿人民围绕这个决定进行了一场激烈的政治斗争。

sentences.en: It's the kind of battle we can expect to see a lot more of
sentences.zh: 随着海平面上升并威胁到世界各地的沿海社区，

sentences.en: as sea levels rise and threaten coastal communities around the world.
sentences.zh: 这种斗争是我们未来会看到更多的类型。

sentences.en: It all started with a scientist who had a radical idea about what to do with the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一位科学家，他对于如何处理灯塔有一个激进的想法。

sentences.en: An idea almost nobody liked.
sentences.zh: 一个几乎没人喜欢的想法。

sentences.en: Let it fall in.
sentences.zh: 让它掉进海里。

sentences.en: Nothing is so important that it can't fall into the sea.
sentences.zh: 没有什么东西是重要到不能掉进海里的。

sentences.en: Why don't you introduce yourself, Oren?
sentences.zh: 奥伦，你不自我介绍一下吗？

sentences.en: Oh yeah, I'm Oren Pilkey.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的，我是奥伦·皮尔基。

sentences.en: I'm a retired marine geologist who started out in the deep sea and ended up on the beaches.
sentences.zh: 我是一位退休的海洋地质学家，起初研究深海，最后转向了海滩。

sentences.en: Oren Pilkey is a professor emeritus at Duke University.
sentences.zh: 奥伦·皮尔基是杜克大学的荣誉退休教授。

sentences.en: He typically wears short-sleeved button-up shirts with two or three pens in the front pocket.
sentences.zh: 他通常穿着短袖衬衫，前口袋里插着两三支笔。

sentences.en: And he studies beaches.
sentences.zh: 他研究海滩。

sentences.en: But there aren't any beaches at Duke because Duke is right in the middle of the state.
sentences.zh: 但杜克大学没有海滩，因为杜克位于该州的中心地带。

sentences.en: So in the 1980s, Oren would pack his students into a bus and head east,
sentences.zh: 所以上世纪80年代，奥伦会把学生们塞进大巴，向东进发，

sentences.en: all the way to the Cape Hatteras Lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 一直开到哈特拉斯角灯塔。

sentences.en: It's usually a pretty exciting place.
sentences.zh: 那通常是个非常令人兴奋的地方。

sentences.en: The average wave height at Cape Hatteras is higher than anywhere else on the east coast,
sentences.zh: 哈特拉斯角的平均浪高比东海岸任何地方都要高，

sentences.en: except possibly northern Maine.
sentences.zh: 除了缅因州北部可能例外。

sentences.en: Oren would tell his students that the waves at Cape Hatteras don't just calmly roll onto shore.
sentences.zh: 奥伦会告诉学生们，哈特拉斯角的浪潮不仅仅是平静地卷上岸边。

sentences.en: They slam into it and spray up into the air.
sentences.zh: 它们会猛烈地撞击海岸，激起漫天水雾。

sentences.en: While his students stared out into the water, Oren explained,
sentences.zh: 当学生们凝视着水面时，奥伦解释道，

sentences.en: these waves are washing away the beach we're standing on.
sentences.zh: 这些海浪正在冲刷我们脚下的这片海滩。

sentences.en: And soon they'll reach the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 很快它们就会到达灯塔。

sentences.en: The shoreline of the Outer Banks, the entire shoreline of the Outer Banks, is eroding.
sentences.zh: 外滩群岛的海岸线，整个外滩群岛的海岸线，正在遭受侵蚀。

sentences.en: And partly this is simply a matter of the waves pecking away at the continent.
sentences.zh: 部分原因仅仅是海浪在不断蚕食大陆。

sentences.en: Ninety percent of the world's beaches are eroding.
sentences.zh: 世界上90%的海滩都在遭受侵蚀。

sentences.en: Some very, very slightly and some very quickly.
sentences.zh: 有些非常非常缓慢，有些则非常迅速。

sentences.en: The beach in front of the lighthouse can erode faSt.
sentences.zh: 灯塔前的海滩侵蚀速度可能很快。

sentences.en: The rates vary wildly from decade to decade.
sentences.zh: 侵蚀率在不同十年间差异巨大。

sentences.en: Sometimes the coast loses 50 feet a year.
sentences.zh: 有时海岸一年会后退50英尺。

sentences.en: Other times the beach actually gains sand.
sentences.zh: 有时海滩实际上又会堆积起沙子。

sentences.en: It's an erratic natural process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不规则的自然过程。

sentences.en: But Oren says climate change is also part of the story.
sentences.zh: 但奥伦说气候变化也是原因之一。

sentences.en: It's speeding up the erosion process.
sentences.zh: 它正在加速侵蚀过程。

sentences.en: For decades, a bunch of different government agencies have been fighting back against the sea.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，许多不同的政府机构一直在与大海抗争。

sentences.en: They tried barriers to slow the waves.
sentences.zh: 他们尝试用屏障来减缓海浪。

sentences.en: They put down a wall of sandbags.
sentences.zh: 他们筑起了一道沙袋墙。

sentences.en: They even tried this thing called beach nourishment.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至尝试了一种叫做“海滩补给”的方法。

sentences.en: That's just a fancy way of saying pumping a ton of sand onto the shore.
sentences.zh: 这只是往岸上倾倒大量沙子的华丽说法。

sentences.en: And they had some other inventive ideas, too.
sentences.zh: 他们还有一些其他别出心裁的想法。

sentences.en: They put in what they call seascape.
sentences.zh: 他们安装了所谓的“海景装置”。

sentences.en: It was plastic, strips of plastic that floated.
sentences.zh: 那是由塑料制成的，漂浮的塑料条。

sentences.en: Strips were supposed to act like seaweed and keep the sand from washing away.
sentences.zh: 这些条带本应像海草一样，防止沙子被冲走。

sentences.en: And here it was.
sentences.zh: 结果就在这儿。

sentences.en: This is a very cheap way to stop erosion of Cape Hattest Lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 这是一种阻止哈特拉斯角灯塔侵蚀的廉价方法。

sentences.en: But it didn't even begin to work.
sentences.zh: 但它根本没起作用。

sentences.en: In fact, none of this stuff worked.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这些方法都没用。

sentences.en: After decades of fighting back against the waves, the ocean was getting dangerously close to the lighthouse,
sentences.zh: 经过几十年的抗浪斗争，海洋已经危险地逼近了灯塔，

sentences.en: less than half a football field away.
sentences.zh: 距离不到半个足球场远。

sentences.en: Basically, we would stand beside the lighthouse and see how this precious historic structure was due to fall in.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们站在灯塔旁边，就能看到这座珍贵的历史建筑即将坠入海中。

sentences.en: I mean, it was easy to see where a good storm would have taken out the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很容易看出哪一场大风暴就会把灯塔摧毁。

sentences.en: It would have to be a Wimdinger storm, but it had gotten to that stage.
sentences.zh: 那必须是一场超级风暴，但情况已经到了那个地步。

sentences.en: And so in 1974, Oren wrote an academic article.
sentences.zh: 于是1974年，奥伦写了一篇学术文章。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: We've tried pretty much everything to protect this lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎尝试了一切方法来保护这座灯塔。

sentences.en: It's time to give up.
sentences.zh: 是时候放弃了。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道，

sentences.en: It is difficult but necessary to come to grips with the ultimate result of living with nature at the shoreline.
sentences.zh: 面对在海岸线与自然共存的最终结果，虽然困难，但却是必要的。

sentences.en: And then he started telling the people of Buxton to let the lighthouse go.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始告诉巴克斯顿的人民放弃这座灯塔。

sentences.en: Which made them really mad.
sentences.zh: 这让他们非常愤怒。

sentences.en: The whole idea of letting things fall in was absolutely outrageous.
sentences.zh: 让东西掉进海里的想法简直是荒谬至极。

sentences.en: Of course we're going to defend us.
sentences.zh: 我们当然要保卫它。

sentences.en: As one corps of engineer colonel said, we're not just going to hold up our hands and slink away.
sentences.zh: 正如一位工程兵团上校所说，我们不会就这样举手投降，灰溜溜地离开。

sentences.en: Most North Carolinians did not want to see the lighthouse fall into the sea.
sentences.zh: 大多数北卡罗来纳人都不想看到灯塔掉进海里。

sentences.en: In 1981, a photographer and conservationist named Hugh Morton started a group called Save the Lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 1981年，一位名叫休·莫顿的摄影师兼环保主义者成立了一个名为“拯救灯塔”的组织。

sentences.en: Schoolchildren across the state raised money to support the group.
sentences.zh: 全州的学生们纷纷筹款支持该组织。

sentences.en: And they recruited prominent North Carolinians, like university presidents, business leaders, and politicians.
sentences.zh: 他们还招募了北卡罗来纳州的知名人士，如大学校长、商界领袖和政客。

sentences.en: Danny, the tour guide from the beginning of the story, he became the local representative for Save the Lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 故事开头的导游丹尼，成为了“拯救灯塔”组织的当地代表。

sentences.en: In terms of uniting political philosophies and, you know, contradictory elements of society, developers, and environmentalists,
sentences.zh: 在团结各种政治哲学，以及社会中矛盾的群体，比如开发商和环保主义者方面，

sentences.en: everybody can rally around the Cape Outers Lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 每个人都能在哈特拉斯角灯塔周围团结起来。

sentences.en: And that was essentially the essence of what was going on.
sentences.zh: 这本质上就是当时发生的事情的核心。

sentences.en: Nothing else mattered.
sentences.zh: 其他一切都不重要了。

sentences.en: It was to do right by that lighthouse and our heritage in this country.
sentences.zh: 重要的是为了这座灯塔和我们国家的遗产做正确的事。

sentences.en: Eventually, Danny settles on one big idea.
sentences.zh: 最终，丹尼提出了一个宏大的想法。

sentences.en: Build a solid concrete wall all the way around the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 在灯塔周围建造一圈坚固的混凝土墙。

sentences.en: I think you can pick and choose your fights with Mother Nature.
sentences.zh: 我认为你可以选择与大自然抗争的时机。

sentences.en: You're not going to win all of them.
sentences.zh: 你不可能赢得每一场战斗。

sentences.en: You've got to pick a fight that you can win.
sentences.zh: 你必须选择一场你能赢的战斗。

sentences.en: Ah, yes.
sentences.zh: 啊，是的。

sentences.en: That was a, it was a very common attitude in those days.
sentences.zh: 那在当时是一种非常普遍的态度。

sentences.en: But my idea was to live with nature at the shoreline.
sentences.zh: 但我的想法是与海岸线的自然环境共存。

sentences.en: Oren thought the seawall would be extremely expensive and ultimately counterproductive.
sentences.zh: 奥伦认为海堤极其昂贵，且最终会适得其反。

sentences.en: Well, seawalls, this is one of the more controversial things that I was saying, others too, that seawalls destroy beaches.
sentences.zh: 嗯，海堤，这是我当时提出的更具争议性的观点之一，其他人也这么说，海堤会摧毁海滩。

sentences.en: Orren had maps and diagrams of the East CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 奥伦有东海岸的地图和图表。

sentences.en: And they showed that seawalls made erosion happen even faster.
sentences.zh: 它们显示海堤反而让侵蚀发生得更快。

sentences.en: He argued that that's exactly what would happen at the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 他认为这正是灯塔会发生的情况。

sentences.en: A wall would make the beach smaller and smaller.
sentences.zh: 墙会让海滩变得越来越小。

sentences.en: So now you're a beach community without a beach.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你成了一个没有海滩的海滨社区。

sentences.en: With this seawall plan, the lighthouse would eventually become a walled island out in the water.
sentences.zh: 有了这个海堤计划，灯塔最终会变成水中的一座围墙孤岛。

sentences.en: Not ideal.
sentences.zh: 这并不理想。

sentences.en: But even if you were fine with that, the wall probably wouldn't hold.
sentences.zh: 但即使你对此没意见，这道墙也可能撑不住。

sentences.en: Oren said it's hard to imagine building a seawall strong enough for the waves at Cape Hatteras.
sentences.zh: 奥伦说，很难想象能建造出足以抵御哈特拉斯角海浪的海堤。

sentences.en: They have lots of big storms at the Cape.
sentences.zh: 哈特拉斯角经常有大型风暴。

sentences.en: Unless the seawall is going to be half the size of the lighthouse, the storm surge would top over the seawall and top of the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 除非海堤能有灯塔一半大，否则风暴潮会越过海堤，淹没灯塔。

sentences.en: Then one day, Oren met an engineer named Dave Fischetti.
sentences.zh: 后来有一天，奥伦遇到了一位名叫戴夫·菲舍蒂的工程师。

sentences.en: Dave said, look, people don't want the lighthouse to fall in.
sentences.zh: 戴夫说，看，人们不想让灯塔掉进海里。

sentences.en: We don't want a seawall, but there's a compromise.
sentences.zh: 我们不想要防波堤，但有一个折中方案。

sentences.en: That thing can be moved.
sentences.zh: 那东西是可以搬走的。

sentences.en: It's around 200 feet tall, about one and a quarter million bricks, and 4,800 tons.
sentences.zh: 它大约有200英尺高，用了约125万块砖，重达4800吨。

sentences.en: But believe it or not, engineers have moved bigger buildings.
sentences.zh: 但信不信由你，工程师们搬动过比这更大的建筑。

sentences.en: This presented a pretty good opportunity for Oren.
sentences.zh: 这对奥伦来说是一个相当好的机会。

sentences.en: He could use the lighthouse to test something that planners call managed retreat.
sentences.zh: 他可以利用这座灯塔来测试规划者所说的“有计划的撤退”。

sentences.en: The idea is that, as sea levels rise, we won't be able to defend every coast with a giant wall.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，随着海平面上升，我们将无法用巨大的围墙保卫每一寸海岸。

sentences.en: Instead, we're going to have to make plans to abandon certain areas and move some things out of the way.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们必须制定计划，放弃某些区域，并将一些设施搬离危险地带。

sentences.en: Oren thought, if Buxton could be convinced to move this big lighthouse, it might show that managed retreat is doable.
sentences.zh: 奥伦心想，如果能说服巴克斯顿镇搬迁这座大灯塔，或许就能证明“有计划的撤退”是可行的。

sentences.en: So he and Dave Fischetti, along with one of Oren's students, Dave Bush, formed their own group.
sentences.zh: 于是，他和戴夫·菲舍蒂，以及奥伦的学生戴夫·布什，组建了自己的团队。

sentences.en: They called themselves the Move the Lighthouse Committee.
sentences.zh: 他们自称为“搬迁灯塔委员会”。

sentences.en: We met together a lot, and we produced a blizzard of papers documenting things about erosion and things about moving buildings, mainly aimed at the media.
sentences.zh: 我们经常聚在一起，撰写了大量关于侵蚀和建筑搬迁的文件，主要是为了引起媒体关注。

sentences.en: So why did you care so much to spend so much of your time?
sentences.zh: 那么，你为什么如此在意，以至于投入了这么多时间？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, it became a challenge, of course.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这当然变成了一种挑战。

sentences.en: It became a—and I guess I got emotionally involved also.
sentences.zh: 它变成了一种……我想我也在情感上投入其中了。

sentences.en: I wasn't going to let that lighthouse fall in in spite of that first article of mine.
sentences.zh: 尽管我写了那篇最初的文章，但我绝不会让那座灯塔倒塌。

sentences.en: So now you got these two groups.
sentences.zh: 所以现在有了这两个阵营。

sentences.en: They both want to preserve the lighthouse, but they're debating how.
sentences.zh: 他们都想保护灯塔，但都在争论该如何保护。

sentences.en: Ultimately, it's up to Congress and the National Park Service, because this is federal property.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这取决于国会和国家公园管理局，因为这是联邦财产。

sentences.en: So the two groups are trying to convince the feds that they have the better plan.
sentences.zh: 所以这两个阵营都在试图说服联邦政府，证明自己的方案更好。

sentences.en: The town of Buxton flatly rejected Oren's Move idea.
sentences.zh: 巴克斯顿镇断然拒绝了奥伦的搬迁想法。

sentences.en: A local magazine did a poll.
sentences.zh: 当地一家杂志做了一项民意调查。

sentences.en: Over 90% of residents wanted to keep the lighthouse in place.
sentences.zh: 超过90%的居民希望让灯塔原地不动。

sentences.en: Many were offended by the very idea of retreat.
sentences.zh: 许多人对“撤退”这个概念本身感到冒犯。

sentences.en: Hugh Morton said retreating from the shoreline would be, quote,
sentences.zh: 休·莫顿说，从海岸线撤退，引用他的话，就是：

sentences.en: ceding man's historic battle against nature.
sentences.zh: 放弃人类与自然的历史性抗争。

sentences.en: And it would make Buxton the laughingstock of the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 而且这会让巴克斯顿成为整个海岸的笑柄。

sentences.en: Danny's group, that's Save the Lighthouse, they felt confident they could win this fight.
sentences.zh: 丹尼的团队，也就是“拯救灯塔”组织，他们确信自己能赢得这场斗争。

sentences.en: And they didn't like these outsiders telling them otherwise.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不喜欢这些外来者对他们指手画脚。

sentences.en: It was a situation of, you know, again, where the local people kind of claim ownership of that.
sentences.zh: 这又是一个当地人宣称对某事物拥有所有权的情况。

sentences.en: And how dare somebody with some out-of-state plates come in here and want to tell these poor dwellers
sentences.zh: 怎么敢有外地车牌的人跑来这里，想要告诉这些生活在

sentences.en: on these shifting, lonely sands what to do with their lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 变幻莫测、荒凉沙滩上的贫苦居民该如何处置他们的灯塔。

sentences.en: I mean, we're not afraid to pick a fight.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们不怕打架。

sentences.en: We're very independent people.
sentences.zh: 我们是非常独立的人。

sentences.en: Danny told me a story to explain the tension between Oren's group and the locals.
sentences.zh: 丹尼给我讲了一个故事，解释了奥伦团队与当地人之间的紧张关系。

sentences.en: He said there was a Duke grad student who would drive down to give talks in Buxton.
sentences.zh: 他说，曾有一名杜克大学的研究生开车下来到巴克斯顿发表演讲。

sentences.en: Danny remembered meeting him one day.
sentences.zh: 丹尼记得有一天遇见了他。

sentences.en: And he proceeded to waltz into a gas station that I was running at the time,
sentences.zh: 他径直走进我当时经营的一家加油站，

sentences.en: filling station, automotive repair shop.
sentences.zh: 那是一个加油站兼汽车修理厂。

sentences.en: And we're changing out us, semi-tires for tractor trailers and stuff.
sentences.zh: 当时我们正在给拖拉机挂车更换半挂车轮胎之类的东西。

sentences.en: And he starts wagging his finger, finger in my face.
sentences.zh: 他开始指着我的鼻子说话。

sentences.en: Don't you know that this lighthouse, we're going to lose this lighthouse, and y'all are obstructionists.
sentences.zh: 难道你们不知道这座灯塔吗？我们要失去这座灯塔了，你们这些人就是阻碍者。

sentences.en: Y'all are, you are, not y'all.
sentences.zh: 你们这些人，你们，不是“你们大家”。

sentences.en: He didn't use, he wasn't a y'all.
sentences.zh: 他没用那个词，他不是那种会说“你们大家”的人。

sentences.en: He said, you are holding this up.
sentences.zh: 他说，是你们在阻挠。

sentences.en: You're holding this project up.
sentences.zh: 你们在阻碍这个项目。

sentences.en: And I'm standing there with like a tire iron in my hand.
sentences.zh: 当时我手里拿着撬胎棒站在那儿。

sentences.en: But Oren and his group had a serious credibility problem in Buxton.
sentences.zh: 但奥伦和他的团队在巴克斯顿面临严重的信任危机。

sentences.en: And they understood why people like Danny were upset.
sentences.zh: 他们也理解为什么像丹尼这样的人会感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Of course, yeah, of course we were outside.
sentences.zh: 当然，是的，我们当然是外来者。

sentences.en: And we were from way far away in Durham.
sentences.zh: 我们来自遥远的达勒姆。

sentences.en: And did this ever give you pause?
sentences.zh: 这有没有让你犹豫过？

sentences.en: I suppose so.
sentences.zh: 我想是有吧。

sentences.en: Going into a community and saying, hey, I know the truth.
sentences.zh: 走进一个社区说，嘿，我知道真相。

sentences.en: And I felt that there was a bit of arrogance in that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那里面带有一点傲慢。

sentences.en: But what was the choice?
sentences.zh: 但还有什么选择呢？

sentences.en: I didn't know anything about how you deal with people, I guess, in this sense.
sentences.zh: 我想，我当时根本不知道在这种情况下该如何与人打交道。

sentences.en: I understood sometimes that I was speaking over their heads.
sentences.zh: 我有时明白自己说的话他们听不懂。

sentences.en: They were saying things that they did not understand or did not want to understand.
sentences.zh: 他们说的话，他们自己并不理解，或者根本不想理解。

sentences.en: And there were other reasons people didn't like Oren's group.
sentences.zh: 人们不喜欢奥伦团队还有其他原因。

sentences.en: Many worried the lighthouse was so big and so old that it would break if you tried to move it.
sentences.zh: 许多人担心灯塔太大太老，如果试图搬动它，它会散架。

sentences.en: Others had strong feelings about the location of the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 还有人对灯塔的位置有很深的情结。

sentences.en: They said it would lose historical value in a new spot.
sentences.zh: 他们说，换个地方它就会失去历史价值。

sentences.en: And then there were also some big money interests.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一些大金主的影响。

sentences.en: Business owners and real estate developers thought a move would hurt their bottom line.
sentences.zh: 企业主和房地产开发商认为搬迁会损害他们的经济利益。

sentences.en: If you own something with a name like the Lighthouse View Motel,
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有一家名字叫“灯塔景观汽车旅馆”的地方，

sentences.en: and then people move the lighthouse out of view, well, you can see the problem.
sentences.zh: 然后人们把灯塔移出了视野，嗯，你可以看出问题所在了。

sentences.en: Throughout the 80s and 90s, there were lots of scientific committees, commissions, studies, and reports.
sentences.zh: 在整个80和90年代，有许多科学委员会、调查团、研究和报告。

sentences.en: They all decided that moving the lighthouse was the best idea.
sentences.zh: 他们都认定搬迁灯塔是最好的主意。

sentences.en: But that didn't do much to convince the locals.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有起到多大作用去说服当地人。

sentences.en: Except for these two local lighthouse historians, Bruce and Cheryl Roberts.
sentences.zh: 除了这两位当地的灯塔历史学家，布鲁斯和谢丽尔·罗伯茨。

sentences.en: Bruce!
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯！

sentences.en: Come on in!
sentences.zh: 快请进！

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Yeah!
sentences.zh: 是啊！

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: You're right on time.
sentences.zh: 你来得正是时候。

sentences.en: Yeah!
sentences.zh: 是啊！

sentences.en: Cheryl wasn't around when I met Bruce.
sentences.zh: 我见到布鲁斯时，谢丽尔不在。

sentences.en: She was busy working on her new lighthouse book.
sentences.zh: 她正忙着写她的新灯塔书。

sentences.en: My wife does most of the writing and I take pictures of lighthouses.
sentences.zh: 我妻子负责大部分写作，我负责拍摄灯塔。

sentences.en: I've actually photographed almost every American lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我几乎拍遍了每一座美国灯塔。

sentences.en: Bruce and Cheryl have basically turned their home into a shrine for lighthouses.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯和谢丽尔基本上把他们的家变成了一个灯塔圣殿。

sentences.en: They've got over a hundred lighthouse books.
sentences.zh: 他们有超过一百本关于灯塔的书。

sentences.en: There's a bunch of miniature lighthouses scattered about.
sentences.zh: 到处散落着一堆微型灯塔模型。

sentences.en: I see countless lighthouse paintings and pictures.
sentences.zh: 我看到了无数的灯塔画作和照片。

sentences.en: And in their study, there's a giant three-panel room divider.
sentences.zh: 在他们的书房里，有一个巨大的三折屏风。

sentences.en: It looks like one of those Japanese screens.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像那种日式屏风。

sentences.en: Only, it's got the Cape Hatteras lighthouse painted on it.
sentences.zh: 只不过上面画的是哈特拉斯角灯塔。

sentences.en: There is something about a lighthouse, I think, that is special.
sentences.zh: 我认为灯塔确实有某种特别之处。

sentences.en: And particularly Hatteras.
sentences.zh: 尤其是哈特拉斯灯塔。

sentences.en: It's the best known one.
sentences.zh: 它是最著名的一座。

sentences.en: Back at the time of the controversy, Bruce and Cheryl were writing a book about the Cape
sentences.zh: 在争议发生时，布鲁斯和谢丽尔正在写一本关于哈特拉斯角

sentences.en: Hatteras lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 灯塔的书。

sentences.en: That's when they started to do some research.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他们开始做一些研究。

sentences.en: We had read the reports that the lighthouse would be loSt.
sentences.zh: 我们读过那些说灯塔将会消失的报告。

sentences.en: And we talked to some of the other scientists who had studied this and made an interesting
sentences.zh: 我们还和一些研究过此事的科学家交谈过，并有一个有趣的

sentences.en: discovery.
sentences.zh: 发现。

sentences.en: The scientists told them that the lighthouse sits on yellow pine timbers.
sentences.zh: 科学家告诉他们，灯塔是建在黄松木梁上的。

sentences.en: They're submerged in a pool of fresh water.
sentences.zh: 它们被浸泡在淡水池中。

sentences.en: It's a strange design.
sentences.zh: 这是一个奇怪的设计。

sentences.en: The builder who constructed the lighthouse knew that if he kept those beams in fresh
sentences.zh: 建造这座灯塔的建筑师知道，如果他能让那些木梁保持在淡水

sentences.en: water, they'd be preserved.
sentences.zh: 中，它们就能被保存下来。

sentences.en: And his plan had worked for over a hundred years.
sentences.zh: 他的计划已经奏效了一百多年。

sentences.en: But here's the problem.
sentences.zh: 但问题就在这里。

sentences.en: The ocean was coming closer and closer to the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 海洋正越来越靠近灯塔。

sentences.en: And the ocean is filled with microorganisms that could degrade the wood.
sentences.zh: 而海洋里充满了会降解木材的微生物。

sentences.en: If the salt water seeped into the foundation, the beams would rot.
sentences.zh: 如果盐水渗入地基，木梁就会腐烂。

sentences.en: And that was the reason that Cheryl and I realized that if nothing else happened, the lighthouse
sentences.zh: 这就是谢丽尔和我意识到的原因，如果什么都不做，灯塔

sentences.en: would begin to tip as that wood foundation was eaten away.
sentences.zh: 就会随着木质地基被侵蚀而开始倾斜。

sentences.en: We actually went and talked to several of the scientists who had signed the study saying
sentences.zh: 我们实际上去和几位签署了那份建议搬迁研究报告的科学家谈过。

sentences.en: it had to be moved.
sentences.zh: 我们确信他们知道自己在做什么，而且这件事是可以做到的。

sentences.en: And we got convinced that they knew what they were doing and that it could be done.
sentences.zh: 这对“搬迁灯塔”团队来说是一个巨大的收获。

sentences.en: This was a huge get for team Move the Lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯和谢丽尔不是那种技术官僚式的外来者。

sentences.en: Bruce and Cheryl weren't technocratic outsiders.
sentences.zh: 他们是灯塔狂热爱好者。

sentences.en: They were lighthouse fanatics.
sentences.zh: 他们说，看吧，不管你喜不喜欢，科学家们确实是对的。

sentences.en: And they were saying, look, like it or not, the scientists are actually right.
sentences.zh: 然后到了1996年，两场大型飓风袭击了北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: Then in 1996, two major hurricanes hit North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 伯莎飓风和弗兰飓风。

sentences.en: Hurricane Bertha and Hurricane Fran.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州、奥克拉科克岛和哈特拉斯岛都处于撤离令之下。

sentences.en: North Carolina and Ocracoke Island and Hatteras Island are under an evacuation mandate.
sentences.zh: 飓风变得越来越频繁，强度也越来越大。

sentences.en: Hurricanes were becoming more frequent and more intense.
sentences.zh: 这产生了一种新的紧迫感。

sentences.en: And this created a new sense of urgency.
sentences.zh: 因此在1997年，国会开始规划潜在的搬迁事宜。

sentences.en: So in 1997, Congress started planning a potential move.
sentences.zh: 在“拯救灯塔”组织成立17年后，经过近二十年的辩论，一场公开

sentences.zh: 会议举行了，以讨论搬迁问题。

sentences.zh: 它是由一位北卡罗来纳州的美国参议员，以及该州的一位州参议员

sentences.zh: 组织的。

sentences.en: region.

sentences.en: It was April 1998.
sentences.zh: 孩子们从各个学校被大巴接来。

sentences.en: About 400 people filed into an aquarium, the largest building in the Outer Banks.
sentences.zh: 有11个新闻组在那里报道这一事件。

sentences.en: Children were bused in from every school.
sentences.zh: 巴克斯顿的人们知道，灯塔的命运可能就在今天这里决定。

sentences.en: There were 11 news crews there reporting on the event.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着“搬走它，否则就失去它”的标语，而另一派则说，“拯救，不要搬走”。

sentences.en: The people of Buxton knew the fate of the lighthouse might be decided here, today.
sentences.zh: 有个家伙走到我面前，抓住我的胳膊说，这是你的贴纸。

sentences.en: They had their move it or lose it signs, and then the others were like, save, not move.
sentences.zh: 我看了看它，说，搬走它，否则就失去一切。

sentences.en: This guy came up to me, grabbed me by the arm, said, here's your sticker.
sentences.zh: 我不想要那该死的贴纸。

sentences.zh: 政客和他们的助手们看着人们站起来为各自的立场作证。

sentences.en: I don't want that damn sticker.
sentences.zh: 每当有人说出对他们阵营有利的话时，他们就会爆发出欢呼声，就像在罗马斗兽场里看着一群角斗士一样。

sentences.en: Politicians and their aides watched as people got up to testify for each side.
sentences.zh: 而和丹尼一起在那里的布鲁斯认为，人群显然是反对

sentences.en: in cheers like you were some of the Roman Coliseum with a bunch of gladiators.
sentences.zh: 呃，我想我当时觉得我们要输了。

sentences.zh: 布鲁斯带着挫败感回到了家。

sentences.en: lighthouse move.
sentences.zh: 他确信国会不会为搬迁提供资金。

sentences.en: Uh, I think I felt that we were going to lose.
sentences.zh: 我想在一两天后，我听到办公室里的电话响了，谢丽尔走过去接听，

sentences.en: Bruce went back home feeling defeated.
sentences.zh: 我听到她说，我说，哦，是的，参议员。

sentences.en: He was convinced Congress was not going to fund the move.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州参议员马克·巴斯奈特在电话那头。

sentences.zh: 他必须睁眼看清事实。

sentences.en: He had to know the facts, the scientific facts.
sentences.zh: 他必须了解真相，科学事实。

sentences.en: This was the critical moment.
sentences.zh: 这是关键时刻。

sentences.en: Cheryl got the senator back on board and he urged Congress to act faSt.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔让参议员回心转意，他敦促国会迅速采取行动。

sentences.en: A few months later, Congress funded the move.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，国会为搬迁提供了资金。

sentences.en: In a last-ditch effort, the local counties sued, but they loSt.
sentences.zh: 当地县政府在最后关头提起诉讼，但他们败诉了。

sentences.en: It was a stinging reminder that even though it may have felt like Buxton's lighthouse, it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 这令人痛苦地提醒人们，尽管这感觉像是巴克斯顿的灯塔，但其实不然。

sentences.en: It belonged to the federal government.
sentences.zh: 它属于联邦政府。

sentences.en: It's an exciting morning here.
sentences.zh: 今天早上这里令人兴奋。

sentences.en: We're live at Cape Hatteras and we're going to have all sorts of folks to talk to.
sentences.zh: 我们正在哈特拉斯角进行现场直播，我们将采访各种各样的人。

sentences.en: The move began on June 17th, 1999.
sentences.zh: 搬迁工作于1999年6月17日开始。

sentences.en: Over 200 journalists swarmed Buxton because nothing like this had ever happened before.
sentences.zh: 200多名记者蜂拥至巴克斯顿，因为以前从未发生过这样的事。

sentences.en: No one had picked up a 4,800-ton lighthouse and moved it over half a mile.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人拿起一座4800吨重的灯塔并将其移动了半英里多。

sentences.en: People called it the move of the millennium.
sentences.zh: 人们称之为千年搬迁工程。

sentences.en: Make sure they know we're rolling the tape from the truck.
sentences.zh: 确保他们知道我们正在从卡车上播放录像。

sentences.en: You're hearing tape from a documentary made by a local TV station.
sentences.zh: 你听到的是当地电视台制作的纪录片录音。

sentences.en: Already there have been 1,800 visitors to the park this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上公园已经有1800名游客了。

sentences.en: That's about double what they usually see coming here this time of year.
sentences.zh: 这大约是往年同期游客量的两倍。

sentences.en: The park service put an orange fence near the base of the lighthouse and tourists lined up along it.
sentences.zh: 公园管理处在灯塔底部附近设置了橙色围栏，游客们沿围栏排起了长队。

sentences.en: But locals sold them t-shirts and hot dogs as everyone waited anxiously.
sentences.zh: 但当地人向他们兜售T恤和热狗，大家都在焦急地等待。

sentences.en: Brian, what do you think about the lighthouse?
sentences.zh: 布莱恩，你觉得这座灯塔怎么样？

sentences.en: What do you think about it?
sentences.zh: 你觉得它怎么样？

sentences.en: It sure is big.
sentences.zh: 它确实很大。

sentences.en: It sure is big.
sentences.zh: 它确实很大。

sentences.en: How are they going to move that?
sentences.zh: 他们打算怎么搬走它？

sentences.en: Can they pick it up?
sentences.zh: 他们能把它抬起来吗？

sentences.en: I'm sorry, but it's heavy.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，它太重了。

sentences.en: It is heavy.
sentences.zh: 它确实很重。

sentences.en: It's very big.
sentences.zh: 它非常大。

sentences.en: The beams created a new foundation, a grid under the lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 这些梁柱构成了一个新的地基，即灯塔下的网格结构。

sentences.en: Okay, open your number ones.
sentences.zh: 好了，打开你们的一号开关。

sentences.en: The pressure at 44.
sentences.zh: 压力在44。

sentences.en: Then they rolled wheels under the steel grid.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在钢网格下装上了轮子。

sentences.en: And using hydraulics, they lifted the whole thing up onto a track leading to the lighthouse's new home.
sentences.zh: 利用液压系统，他们将整个建筑抬起，放在通往灯塔新家的轨道上。

sentences.en: Keep a close watch now.
sentences.zh: 现在仔细观察。

sentences.en: Up we go.
sentences.zh: 我们要升起来了。

sentences.en: Okay, coming up.
sentences.zh: 好了，上来了。

sentences.en: Okay, the lighthouse is up off the shoring.
sentences.zh: 好了，灯塔已经脱离了支撑架。

sentences.en: She's on our jacks.
sentences.zh: 它现在由我们的千斤顶支撑着。

sentences.en: The engineers were all ready to roll.
sentences.zh: 工程师们已经准备好开动了。

sentences.en: They pulled a giant lever and the lighthouse started to inch forward.
sentences.zh: 他们拉动了一个巨大的杠杆，灯塔开始缓慢向前移动。

sentences.en: If you were there that day in the crowd, this all would have looked anticlimactic because the lighthouse moved so slow.
sentences.zh: 如果你那天在人群中，这一切看起来会很平淡，因为灯塔移动得太慢了。

sentences.en: That was it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: Can you see it?
sentences.zh: 你能看到吗？

sentences.en: You couldn't even tell.
sentences.zh: 你甚至都看不出来。

sentences.en: The rangers had to put markers along the track just so you could be sure that it did, in fact, move.
sentences.zh: 护林员不得不沿着轨道放置标记，好让你确信它确实在移动。

sentences.en: It's just going real, real slow.
sentences.zh: 它只是走得非常、非常慢。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, now I see it.
sentences.zh: 对，对，现在我看到了。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: And you're lucky to be here to see it.
sentences.zh: 你能在这里见证这一幕真是幸运。

sentences.en: At the end of the first day, the lighthouse had only moved 10 feet.
sentences.zh: 第一天结束时，灯塔只移动了10英尺。

sentences.en: This whole process would take weeks.
sentences.zh: 整个过程需要几周时间。

sentences.en: Oh, my word.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: It's still going.
sentences.zh: 它还在动。

sentences.en: It's still going, yep.
sentences.zh: 它还在动，没错。

sentences.en: Slowly but surely.
sentences.zh: 缓慢而坚定。

sentences.en: Bruce remembers showing up one day near the end of the move.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯记得在搬迁快结束时有一天去过现场。

sentences.en: He saw Danny coming towards him through the crowd.
sentences.zh: 他看到丹尼穿过人群向他走来。

sentences.en: Danny told him, they're moving it too faSt.
sentences.zh: 丹尼告诉他，他们搬得太快了。

sentences.en: I'm stunned.
sentences.zh: 我惊呆了。

sentences.en: I said, what's wrong with moving it too fast?
sentences.zh: 我说，搬得太快有什么不好？

sentences.en: He says, look, every restaurant is making money.
sentences.zh: 他说，你看，每家餐馆都在赚钱。

sentences.en: Every hotel is making money.
sentences.zh: 每家酒店都在赚钱。

sentences.en: We have never had crowds like this ever before.
sentences.zh: 我们以前从来没有过这么多游客。

sentences.en: And he said, if you can just slow it down until September, we'll all be rich.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果你能把它拖到九月再搬完，我们都会发财的。

sentences.en: Slow it down, slow it down, slow it down.
sentences.zh: 慢一点，慢一点，慢一点。

sentences.en: We've got five inches to go.
sentences.zh: 还剩五英寸。

sentences.en: Four inches.
sentences.zh: 四英寸。

sentences.en: As the lighthouse inched to its new home, it was again 1,600 feet from shore, the exact same
sentences.zh: 当灯塔缓慢移向新家时，它再次回到了距离海岸1600英尺的地方，这与1870年海浪冲走海滩前

sentences.en: distance it was in 1870, before the sea washed the beach away.
sentences.zh: 的距离完全相同。

sentences.en: Before the move, the people of Buxton felt something terrible and undemocratic was happening to them.
sentences.zh: 搬迁前，巴克斯顿的居民感到一种可怕且不民主的事情正在发生在他们身上。

sentences.en: These out-of-towners were destroying the heart and soul of their island.
sentences.zh: 这些外地人正在摧毁他们岛屿的心脏和灵魂。

sentences.en: The community fought hard, and they loSt.
sentences.zh: 社区进行了激烈的抗争，但他们失败了。

sentences.en: But in a strange way, things actually worked out for them.
sentences.zh: 但奇怪的是，事情对他们来说结果反而不错。

sentences.en: I look back at this, you know, after this is all said and done.
sentences.zh: 你知道，回首往事，在这一切尘埃落定之后。

sentences.en: Was moving that lighthouse the right thing to do?
sentences.zh: 搬迁那座灯塔是正确的做法吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it was.
sentences.zh: 是的，是正确的。

sentences.en: So he's had a complete change of heart.
sentences.zh: 所以他彻底改变了想法。

sentences.en: And he's not alone.
sentences.zh: 而且他并不孤单。

sentences.en: In fact, most people think that the move was the best thing that ever happened to Buxton.
sentences.zh: 事实上，大多数人认为这次搬迁是巴克斯顿发生过的最好的事情。

sentences.en: Something as monumental as moving America's lighthouse put us on a national radar, on an
sentences.zh: 像搬迁美国灯塔这样具有里程碑意义的事情让我们进入了全国视野，进入了

sentences.en: international radar, and people started thinking about the Outer Banks.
sentences.zh: 国际视野，人们开始关注外滩群岛。

sentences.en: It was a raging success.
sentences.zh: 这是一次巨大的成功。

sentences.en: Danny doesn't look back now and see the move as a cowardly retreat.
sentences.zh: 丹尼现在回首往事，并不认为这次搬迁是一种懦弱的退缩。

sentences.en: He sees it as a testament to human ingenuity.
sentences.zh: 他将其视为人类智慧的证明。

sentences.en: This all makes Oren hopeful.
sentences.zh: 这一切让奥伦看到了希望。

sentences.en: Because if Danny can change his views, maybe others will too.
sentences.zh: 因为如果丹尼能改变他的观点，也许其他人也会。

sentences.en: You know, I think the moving the lighthouse was a profound event in terms of our response to sea level rise.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为搬迁灯塔在我们应对海平面上升方面是一个深远的事件。

sentences.en: I think the Cape Hattos lighthouse is kind of a good example of what we're going to be doing a lot in the future.
sentences.zh: 我认为哈特拉斯角灯塔是一个很好的例子，展示了我们未来将要做很多的事情。

sentences.en: If you can move a 3,000 or whatever it is, ton lighthouse, you can move a lot of cottages.
sentences.zh: 如果你能移动一座3000吨（或者不管多少吨）的灯塔，你就能移动很多小屋。

sentences.en: But it's not just lighthouses and beach cottages.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是灯塔和海滩小屋的问题。

sentences.en: There are thousands of miles of vulnerable U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国有数千英里的海岸线

sentences.en: coastline.
sentences.zh: 处于危险之中。

sentences.en: The Battle of Buxton is just a preview of the tough choices we'll have to make.
sentences.zh: 巴克斯顿之战只是我们将要面临的艰难选择的一个预演。

sentences.en: We have 3,000 miles of barrier on a shoreline.
sentences.zh: 我们有3000英里的海岸屏障。

sentences.en: So whatever happens here is also happening in Galveston and also is happening in Myrtle Beach and Jekyll Island, Georgia.
sentences.zh: 所以这里发生的一切，也正在加尔维斯顿、默特尔比奇和佐治亚州的杰基尔岛发生。

sentences.en: And they're all going to be asking for money from the feds.
sentences.zh: 他们都会向联邦政府要钱。

sentences.en: We need money.
sentences.zh: 我们需要钱。

sentences.en: We need money.
sentences.zh: 我们需要钱。

sentences.en: We need to nourish the beach or we need help building a seawall.
sentences.zh: 我们需要滋养海滩，或者我们需要帮助建造海堤。

sentences.en: But it ain't going to be there.
sentences.zh: 但钱不会凭空而来。

sentences.en: That's why retreat is important.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么撤退很重要。

sentences.en: By the year 2100, at least 500 U.S.
sentences.zh: 到2100年，至少有500个美国

sentences.en: communities will be at risk from sea level rise, including major cities like Miami and New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 社区将面临海平面上升的风险，包括迈阿密和新奥尔良等大城市。

sentences.en: That's according to the Union of Concerned Scientists.
sentences.zh: 这是根据忧思科学家联盟的说法。

sentences.en: And then there's the millions of people in other parts of the world, in countries like Bangladesh or the Solomon Islands, that are already being badly affected.
sentences.zh: 还有世界上其他地区，比如孟加拉国或所罗门群岛等国家的数百万人，他们已经受到了严重影响。

sentences.en: If people get this worked up about a lighthouse, imagine how hard it'll be when we start talking about moving entire cities.
sentences.zh: 如果人们对一座灯塔都如此激动，想象一下当我们开始谈论搬迁整个城市时会有多困难。

sentences.en: How can you do that fairly and in a way that doesn't devastate communities?
sentences.zh: 你如何公平地做到这一点，且不破坏社区？

sentences.en: We're going to be fighting this battle over and over again.
sentences.zh: 我们将不得不一次又一次地进行这场战斗。

sentences.en: And after all of this, the Cape Hatteras Lighthouse will probably have to move again.
sentences.zh: 而在这一切之后，哈特拉斯角灯塔可能还得再次搬迁。

sentences.en: It might last 100 years at its current location, but some scientists say it could be even less than that.
sentences.zh: 它在目前的位置可能还能维持100年，但一些科学家说可能连这都不到。

sentences.en: We have another high-stakes story of a building being moved, but this time, all the people were in it when it happened.
sentences.zh: 我们还有另一个关于建筑搬迁的高风险故事，但这一次，搬迁时里面住满了人。

sentences.en: Right after this.
sentences.zh: 稍后回来。

sentences.en: Sometimes moving a building is about preserving historic architecture or cultural heritage.
sentences.zh: 有时搬迁建筑是为了保护历史建筑或文化遗产。

sentences.en: But a 99PI fan named Tamara Solorzano wrote us about an unusually high-stakes move that happened in her hometown of Guadalajara, Mexico.
sentences.zh: 但一位名叫塔玛拉·索洛扎诺的99PI粉丝写信告诉我们，在她的家乡墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉发生了一次极其高风险的搬迁。

sentences.en: And Kurt Kolstad is here to tell us about it.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔斯塔德在这里为我们讲述这件事。

sentences.en: So back in 1950, city officials in Guadalajara decided to widen a major avenue to accommodate more traffic.
sentences.zh: 1950年，瓜达拉哈拉的城市官员决定拓宽一条主要大道以容纳更多交通。

sentences.en: And a lot of buildings were just demolished to make way.
sentences.zh: 许多建筑被拆除以腾出空间。

sentences.en: But there is a problem.
sentences.zh: 但有一个问题。

sentences.en: There is this one 1,700-ton brick structure occupied by the Mexican Telephone and Telegraph Company.
sentences.zh: 有一座1700吨重的砖结构建筑，由墨西哥电话电报公司占用。

sentences.en: So why not demolish this building along with the rest of the buildings they demolish when they widen the street?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么不在拓宽街道时把这座建筑和其他被拆除的建筑一起拆掉呢？

sentences.en: Well, it would have been more expensive, but it also would have knocked out regional telephone service for at least a week.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那样做成本会更高，而且至少会中断区域电话服务一周。

sentences.en: And that's where Jorge Matute-Remos comes in.
sentences.zh: 这就是豪尔赫·马图特-雷莫斯登场的地方。

sentences.en: He's the civil engineer, and he's the dean of the city's university.
sentences.zh: 他是土木工程师，也是该市大学的院长。

sentences.en: And he has this idea to move the building while leaving everything wired up and keeping the operators at work inside it.
sentences.zh: 他有一个想法，在保持所有线路连接、让接线员在里面继续工作的同时搬迁这座建筑。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Well, that must have made them pretty nervous.
sentences.zh: 那一定让他们很紧张。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, and Matute-Remos was definitely sympathetic to that, and he wanted to reassure the operators and make them feel safe.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，马图特-雷莫斯对此深表同情，他想让接线员们放心，让他们感到安全。

sentences.en: So his wife, Esmeralda, agreed to also go into the building while it was being moved.
sentences.zh: 所以他的妻子埃斯梅拉达同意在搬迁过程中也进入大楼。

sentences.en: And she even took along their seven-year-old son, Juan Jorge.
sentences.zh: 她甚至带上了他们七岁的儿子胡安·豪尔赫。

sentences.en: And Matute-Remos has since passed on, but here's this lovely clip of his widow talking about the move on Televisa News.
sentences.zh: 马图特-雷莫斯已经去世了，但这里有一段他遗孀在Televisa新闻上谈论这次搬迁的珍贵片段。

sentences.en: So she says she and her son, Juan Jorge, were inside the building to gain their trust,
sentences.zh: 她说她和儿子胡安·豪尔赫待在大楼里是为了赢得他们的信任，

sentences.en: and they didn't even feel the tiniest movement when they moved the whole building and all the operators inside it.
sentences.zh: 当他们移动整座大楼和里面的所有接线员时，他们甚至感觉不到一丝晃动。

sentences.en: That's so cool.
sentences.zh: 太酷了。

sentences.en: Yeah, and so basically it all went really well.
sentences.zh: 是的，基本上一切都进行得非常顺利。

sentences.en: Well, the building was slowly shifted about 40 feet to its new location, and, yeah, the people inside didn't feel a thing.
sentences.zh: 大楼被缓慢地平移了约40英尺到新位置，是的，里面的人什么感觉都没有。

sentences.en: They kept working, and the whole move was done in just five days with no interruption to phone service, very critical.
sentences.zh: 他们继续工作，整个搬迁仅用了五天就完成了，没有中断电话服务，这非常关键。

sentences.en: And they did it on a budget of around $100,000, which was a fraction of what it would have cost to demolish the structure and then build some replacement.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的预算约为10万美元，这只是拆除结构再建新楼成本的一小部分。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so this was about how long ago?
sentences.zh: 那么这是多久以前的事了？

sentences.en: About 70 years ago.
sentences.zh: 大约70年前。

sentences.en: 70 years ago?
sentences.zh: 70年前？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And so the building, is it still there?
sentences.zh: 那么那栋建筑，它还在那里吗？

sentences.en: Is it along this new Wieden Road?
sentences.zh: 是在新维登路那边吗？

sentences.en: It is, and Matute Ramos has a pretty unique memorial statue right outside the building.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且马图特·拉莫斯在建筑外有一座相当独特的纪念雕像。

sentences.en: It's this life-size figure of him, and they actually positioned it so it looks like he's physically pushing the structure by hand.
sentences.zh: 那是一个和他真人一样大小的雕像，他们特意把它摆放成他正用手推着建筑的样子。

sentences.en: That's so cool.
sentences.zh: 太酷了。

sentences.en: Yeah, and next to that sculpture, of course, there's a plaque dedicated to his civil service and engineering genius.
sentences.zh: 是啊，而且在雕像旁边，当然还有一块纪念他公共服务贡献和工程天赋的牌匾。

sentences.en: Oh, that's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And special thanks to Tamara for sending that in to us, too.
sentences.zh: 还要特别感谢塔玛拉给我们发来这些信息。

sentences.en: Really neat story.
sentences.zh: 真是个精彩的故事。

sentences.en: And you can see a video of the move and images of that cool statue of Matute Ramos on our website.
sentences.zh: 你可以在我们的网站上看到搬迁过程的视频，以及马图特·拉莫斯那座酷炫雕像的照片。

sentences.en: It's 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是 99pi.org。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Gordon Kadik and Sam Fenn of Cited PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由 Cited 播客的戈登·卡迪克和萨姆·芬恩制作。

sentences.en: That's C-I-T-E-D, like an academic citation.
sentences.zh: 就是 C-I-T-E-D，学术引用的那个词。

sentences.en: They do stories about research and higher education.
sentences.zh: 他们专门制作关于研究和高等教育的故事。

sentences.en: You can find their work at citedpodcaSt.com.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 citedpodcast.com 找到他们的作品。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Mike Boer, Phil Evans, and Stavros Avramidis.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢迈克·波尔、菲尔·埃文斯和斯塔夫罗斯·阿夫拉米迪斯。
zh_words: 斯塔夫罗斯·阿夫拉米迪斯

sentences.en: Thanks also to WRAL-TV for letting us use their documentary, The Cape Light, Away from the Edge.
sentences.zh: 还要感谢 WRAL-TV 允许我们使用他们的纪录片《海角之光：远离边缘》。

sentences.en: You can find a link to the full program on our website.
sentences.zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到完整节目的链接。

sentences.en: From our staff, this piece was produced and edited by Delaney Hall.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由我们的工作人员德莱尼·霍尔制作和剪辑。

sentences.en: Mix and tech production by Sharif Youssef.
sentences.zh: 混音和技术制作由谢里夫·优素福负责。

sentences.en: Music by Sean Riel.
sentences.zh: 音乐由肖恩·里尔创作。

sentences.en: Katie Mingle is our senior producer.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂·明格尔是我们的资深制作人。

sentences.en: Kurt Kolstad is the digital director.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔斯塔德是数字总监。

sentences.en: The rest of the staff includes Avery Truffelman, Emmett Fitzgerald, Taryn Mazza, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 其他工作人员包括艾弗里·特鲁费尔曼、埃米特·菲茨杰拉德、塔琳·马扎，以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW in San Francisco and produced on Radio Row in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 KALW 的一个项目，在加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心美丽的广播街制作。

sentences.en: We are a part of Radiotopia from PRX, a collective of the best, most innovative shows in all of podcasting.
sentences.zh: 我们是 PRX 旗下 Radiotopia 的一部分，这是一个汇集了播客界最优秀、最具创新性节目的联盟。

sentences.en: We are supported by listeners just like you.
sentences.zh: 我们由像你一样的听众支持。

sentences.en: And if you supported us in the last drive, well, you should be checking your mailboxes.
sentences.zh: 如果你在上次募捐活动中支持了我们，那么，你应该留意一下你的邮箱了。

sentences.en: These are exciting times.
sentences.zh: 现在是一个令人兴奋的时刻。

sentences.en: You can find 99% Invisible and join discussions about the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到《99%隐形》并参与节目讨论。

sentences.en: You can tweet at me at Roman Mars and the show at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以在推特上关注我 @romanmars，或者关注节目 @99pi。

sentences.en: We're on Instagram, Tumblr, and Reddit too.
sentences.zh: 我们也在 Instagram、Tumblr 和 Reddit 上。

sentences.en: We have more visual design stories and videos too at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 你还可以在 99pi.org 找到更多视觉设计故事和视频。
